iWant: Squire to draft and ask, and to send, publish, delete, overwrite or install only when I have said yes to that one thing
soThat: nothing happens in my name, to my things or on my Mac that I did not agree to
description: The safety floor: approval is explicit and for one item, silence is not approval, the Rule of Two always applies, and nothing destructive and no install happens without a yes. These rules are core's and are not overlayable: an overlay in the Squire owner's folder at a safety rule's path is ignored. Publishing and deploying a website meet the first criterion again when websites are built.
title: Safety, always on: nothing is sent, deleted or installed without a yes

acceptanceCriteria.description: Nothing is sent or goes live without the Squire owner's yes for that item.
acceptanceCriteria.given: Squire has drafted a message to send, a page to publish or a site to deploy, and the Squire owner has not said yes to it. Core's safety rules apply whatever the Squire owner's folder holds; an overlay there cannot change them.
acceptanceCriteria.when: Squire, or a tool it calls, tries to send, publish or deploy it
acceptanceCriteria.then: The action is blocked and nothing is sent, published or deployed; once the Squire owner says yes to that item, it may proceed.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A yes covers one thing, a no is never reused, and silence is never a yes.
acceptanceCriteria.given: Two actions, A and B, each need the Squire owner's yes. Core's safety rules apply whatever the Squire owner's folder holds; an overlay there cannot change them.
acceptanceCriteria.when: The Squire owner says yes to A only, says no to another request, and a request for a yes then goes unanswered until it times out
acceptanceCriteria.then: A may proceed; B stays blocked; the item the Squire owner said no to stays blocked, and that no is never reused as the answer for another attempt or another item; the action whose request timed out is not done and is never recorded as approved.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Squire never runs a job that mixes untrusted input, the Squire owner's private things and an action out in the world: it splits the job and asks the Squire owner at the join.
acceptanceCriteria.given: A job that carries all three: untrusted input (such as a web page or an incoming message), access to the Squire owner's private things, and an action out in the world. Core's safety rules apply whatever the Squire owner's folder holds; an overlay there cannot change them. (Note 2026-11-07: moved from round 1 to round 2 after a second review finding that word-based detection of inbox reads is incomplete; round 2 defines the resolve-or-ask read rule.)
acceptanceCriteria.when: Squire is asked to run it
acceptanceCriteria.then: The job is refused as one job; Squire splits it so that no part holds all three, and the part after the join waits for the Squire owner's yes.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Nothing of the Squire owner's is deleted or overwritten without their yes.
acceptanceCriteria.given: Files in the Squire owner's folder and things Squire built for the Squire owner, and no yes to change them. Core's safety rules apply whatever the Squire owner's folder holds; an overlay there cannot change them.
acceptanceCriteria.when: Squire, or a tool it calls, tries to delete, overwrite, move over or empty one of them
acceptanceCriteria.then: The action is blocked and the file is unchanged; once the Squire owner says yes to that item, it may proceed. Squire's own scratch space is outside this criterion.

acceptanceCriteria.description: No software is installed without the Squire owner's yes.
acceptanceCriteria.given: No yes from the Squire owner for a given piece of software. Core's safety rules apply whatever the Squire owner's folder holds; an overlay there cannot change them.
acceptanceCriteria.when: Squire, or a tool it calls, tries to install a package or run a downloaded program
acceptanceCriteria.then: The install or run is refused and nothing is installed; once the Squire owner says yes to exactly that software, it may proceed.
